explication: automaxprocs is a small Go library that adjusts Go’s GOMAXPROCS to match a Linux container CPU quota. The documented workflow is to blank-import the top-level package, which invokes the configurable maxprocs API; that API obtains a quota-derived value and applies it to the Go runtime. Linux quota discovery supports both cgroups v1 and v2. The excerpts show the key dispatch and parsing relationships; unsampled cgroup internals are represented without inferred calls.
